두 사람이 동시에 가위, 바위, 보 중 하나를 낸다. 가위는 보를 이긴다: Two people each throw one of scissors, rock, or paper at the same time. Scissors beats paper, rock beats scissors, paper beats rock. If they throw the same thing, it is a tie.
두 사람이 동시에 가위, 바위, 보 중 하나를 낸다. 보는 가위를 이긴다: Two people each throw one of scissors, rock, or paper at the same time. Paper beats scissors, scissors beats rock, rock beats paper. If they throw the same thing, it is a tie.
내가 지려면 무엇을 내야 하는가?: What must I throw to lose?
내가 이기려면 무엇을 내야 하는가?: What must I throw to win?
The opponent will throw either scissors or paper. I do not know which of the two they will throw.
상대가 무엇을 내든 지지 않으려면 나는 무엇을 내야 하는가?: What must I throw so that I do not lose, whatever the opponent throws?
The opponent will throw either paper or rock. I do not know which of the two they will throw.
